_about: Machine-readable copy of MECHANICS.md. Values are design values, not tested. Attribute ids checked against mod_files/data.cdb on 2026-10-24.

mechanics.name: No shields, no firearms
mechanics.notes: Never give Ginaz units shield or firearm equipment; remove those slots on takeover units.

mechanics.name: Throwers allowed (daggers are not firearms)
mechanics.notes: Rule text should say no firearms and no shields, not no ranged.

mechanics.name: School of the Sword: movement speed
mechanics.notes: Melee infantry. Evasion half is G-04.

mechanics.name: Evasion (School of the Sword)
mechanics.notes: No evasion attribute exists. Stand-in is extra armour; in-game text must say so.

mechanics.name: Martial Honor: parry
mechanics.notes: No parry attribute exists. A parry negates the hit; stand-in is damage reduction.

mechanics.name: Riposte stacks
mechanics.notes: Buildable if stacks are fed by hits (v1). Parry-fed (v2) is APPROX. Decide which.

mechanics.name: Swordmaster Discipline: upkeep
mechanics.notes: Exact. Value convention confirmed: an MRatio trait value is a multiplier (vanilla TDesertCommand uses 0.8 on this attribute).

mechanics.name: Swordmaster Discipline: Deep Desert supply

values.condition: unit inside a DeepDesert region (built in, no custom condition needed)

mechanics.notes: Army_DeepDesertDailySupplyDrain_MRatio is '% daily supply drain in DeepDesert'. The location test is built in. Closest vanilla reference: trait DesertMastery. Multiplier 0.5 = -50 %.

mechanics.name: Kanly Retribution

values.rival_stand_in: faction at War with the Ginaz unit

mechanics.notes: No Kanly rival state exists. The closest state is War (Me_IsAtWarWith_Amount, Me_Track_StartWar). Traits can be given to units at war and per war to a faction, but no melee attribute is conditioned on the target being at war, so the +30 % must go through a unit-in-war trait (approximation).

mechanics.name: Name Champion
mechanics.notes: Copy the Ecaz Champion system. Health attribute still to be found. Part of the reconciled 5K proposal (Appointment of a Duelist).

mechanics.name: Ritual Duel
mechanics.notes: Needs an ability that applies a trait to one target. Also Jool's active and Cassian's Dueling Glove.

mechanics.name: Master Dueling (kill Hegemony)
mechanics.notes: Needs a kill trigger. Option B of G-13.

mechanics.name: Declare Kanly
mechanics.notes: 'Kanly' exists only as a game mode (Kanly Duel: two factions, 30 days, with Kanly_Global and Kanly_MainBase traits). A Kanly against one faction does not exist. Stand-in: declare War as the feud.

mechanics.name: Assassin Contracts
mechanics.notes: Needs an operation-complete trigger. Option B of G-13.

mechanics.name: Sword-School Aura (10 m)
mechanics.notes: Radius auras need a real in-game test. Stand-ins: attack speed and armour.

mechanics.name: Avoidance cap
mechanics.notes: Caps evasion plus parry. Confirm before coding G-04, G-05 and G-20.

open_questions: Can a trait condition test 'in the Deep Desert' (G-08)?
Can a trait condition test 'target faction has an active Kanly' (G-09)?
Is there an attribute that negates damage by chance (G-05)?
Which equipment definitions give shields or ranged weapons to Atreides units (G-01)?
What does the Kanly game mode do, and can Ginaz reuse it (G-18)?
Which ability entries apply a trait to one target (G-16)?

findings: gameMode 'Kanly' = 'Kanly Duel': two factions, shortGameDays 30, baseFactionXp 50. A whole-game format, not a feud between two factions.

Traits Kanly_Global (Authority +100 %, agent production +100 %, Plascrete +50 %, mission prep -50 %, and more) and Kanly_MainBase (armour +1, life x0.5, construction +50 %) exist. No sheet references them; the engine probably applies them in that mode (unverified).
mapType 'Kanly': 60 cells, one desert region, two mountain regions, 4-5 specials, base slots.
Factions start with Solari 3000 and Plascrete 1500 in Kanly (Vernius Solari 4000).
Constants: Kanly_Max_Players = 2; AI_DiplomaticTarget_Kanly_Weight = 10 on all difficulties; Game_Victory_GovernorDuration = 25 in Kanly (30 default).
Achievements: KanlyWin ('Duelist', win a Kanly); AmtalRule (win a multiplayer Kanly against a player with this achievement).
No condition, attribute or trait tests 'target faction has an active Kanly' or 'rival'. G-09 and G-18 cannot use a Kanly state.

Closest diplomatic states: War and Peace (Me_IsAtWarWith_Amount, Me_Track_StartWar, Me_Track_MakePeace, DeclareWar_Cost_ARatio, Faction_GiveTTrait_AtWar, Entity_GiveTTrait_UnitAtWar_AtTRange2, Armies_AtTRange2_AtWar_GainTTrait).
Army_DeepDesertDailySupplyDrain_MRatio: '% daily supply drain in DeepDesert' (exact for G-08).
Army_InDeepDesert_GainTTrait and Army_Ground_InDeepDesert_GainTTrait: units in a DeepDesert gain a trait (location test built in).
Unit_DD_NoSpeedLoss and Unit_DD_GroundSpeed_MRatio exist (vanilla desert movement).
*_MRatio attributes: trait value is a multiplier (1 = no change). NoUpkeep = 0, TDesertCommand = 0.8, CBattle_Assault = 0.5 on Army_StockUpkeep_MRatio.
